info.title: InspiredLearning API
info.description: Shared verified Google identity and existing owner/facilitator permissions. Resource catalogs and all writes require a current global facilitator. Explicit token permissions apply on every request. Credits use latest published workshop results, preserve three separate measures and unknown null values. College affiliations are explicit, never inferred. Writes require a UUID Idempotency-Key and review reason; updates also require current expectedVersion. MCP remains read-only. Unified student credits award final team score plus individual score per completed workshop, intentionally counting individual credits twice. Legacy learning points remain compatibility data and are excluded from the unified total.

401.description: Google sign-in required

post.description: Creates a token with selected permissions, optional learner/workshop restrictions and a 1, 7 or 30-day expiry. Requires global facilitator Google sign-in confirmed within the last five minutes and a UUID Idempotency-Key. The secret is returned once; identical retries return metadata with secret=null. Save it immediately, or revoke and replace it if lost. Maximum 25 active unexpired tokens per administrator. API tokens cannot create tokens.

post.description: Creates a college using a stable lowercase collegeId (2–64 characters), display name and active/inactive status. An existing ID returns 409. Token callers require colleges:write. No learner membership or workshop assignment is created automatically. Requires a current global facilitator or an admin-issued token with the explicit write permission. Send a JSON body with a review reason and a UUID Idempotency-Key header. Identical retries return the original result; reusing the key for different settings returns 409. Resource restrictions and removal rules are enforced on every request.

get.summary: List unified student credit totals across Inspi

parameters.name: workshopId
parameters.description: Optional contribution filter. Omit for the total across Inspi.

401.description: Verified Google Firebase ID token required

409.description: Stale revision, ambiguous email or conflicting retry

get.description: Returns one credit total per authorized student across all completed published workshops and non-workshop credit entries. Each workshop contributes final team score PLUS individual score; counting individual credits again is an intentional attendance benefit. The legacy fixed 100 learning points are excluded. Latest records count once; corrections replace their contribution and revocations remove it. No workshopId is required. Optional collegeId and workshopId filters select affiliations and contributions. Use limit (25 default, 100 maximum) and nextCursor to retrieve all pages, even after an empty page. Global facilitator access and scores:read for API tokens are required. Workshop-restricted tokens must provide a permitted workshopId. Unknown awarded components produce totalCredits=null with knownCredits and unknownAwards; no partial value is labeled as the total. Accounts exceeding 500 records per source fail rather than truncate. New adjustments are recorded prospectively; existing published snapshots are included without republishing.

Publication, correction, revocation and reinstatement each record one change per result revision. Private review reasons are excluded. Existing historical awards count in the total even if they predate this log; this log is not a complete historical balance ledger. Pagination uses limit and nextCursor; continue even after an empty filtered page. Removed or blocked workshop records remain unavailable.
